manifest.notes: Release Desk on Sepolia. LaunchToken (src/LaunchToken.sol) is the fixed-supply Desk (DESK) ERC-20 with 18 decimals and no constructor arguments; it mints its whole supply once to the deployer (the factory) and has no mint, owner or admin functions. OTCBoard (src/OTCBoard.sol) is a fixed-price board where makers sell any ERC-20 for Sepolia ETH. Its only constructor argument is address featuredToken_, filled with $token so the site defaults to DESK; it reverts on the zero address, holds no DESK at deploy, and has no owner, admin, fee, upgrade path, receive or fallback. No $owner argument is used and no initialization calls are made. The pool pairs DESK with native ETH (zero address), fee 3000, tickSpacing 60, no hook; initialPrice is sqrtPriceX96 for 1:1 and is superseded by the policy opening market cap where the pinned policy specifies one.
